sentences.chinese: 杂草来到罗森海姆附近的一个地方。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo lái dào luó sēn hǎi mǔ fù jìn de yí gè dì fāng 。
sentences.english: Weed comes to a place near Rosenheim.

sentences.pinyin: nà lǐ yǐ qián hěn ān jìng 。
sentences.english: Before, it was very quiet there.

sentences.chinese: 可是现在，很多人离开了家。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì xiàn zài ， hěn duō rén lí kāi le jiā 。
sentences.english: But now, many people have left their homes.

sentences.chinese: 一些可怕的人来到那里。
sentences.pinyin: yì xiē kě pà de rén lái dào nà lǐ 。
sentences.english: Some frightening people have come there.

sentences.pinyin: hěn duō dà rén bèi dài zǒu le 。
sentences.english: Many adults have been taken away.

sentences.pinyin: hái zi hé lǎo rén liú xià lái 。
sentences.english: Children and old people are left behind.

sentences.pinyin: yí gè lǎo rén zhǎo dào zá cǎo 。
sentences.english: An old man finds Weed.

sentences.chinese: 老人手里有一个小东西。
sentences.pinyin: lǎo rén shǒu lǐ yǒu yí gè xiǎo dōng xī 。
sentences.english: The old man has a small object in his hand.

sentences.chinese: 老人告诉他，这个东西很珍贵。
sentences.pinyin: lǎo rén gào sù tā ， zhè ge dōng xī hěn zhēn guì 。
sentences.english: The old man tells him that this object is very precious.

sentences.pinyin: kě shì lǎo rén méi yǒu jīn bì 。
sentences.english: But the old man has no coins.

sentences.pinyin: tā zhǐ yǒu zhè ge xiǎo dōng xī 。
sentences.english: He only has this small object.

sentences.chinese: 他希望杂草帮助那些大人。
sentences.pinyin: tā xī wàng zá cǎo bāng zhù nà xiē dà rén 。
sentences.english: He hopes Weed will help those adults.

sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo kàn zhe lǎo rén 。
sentences.english: Weed looks at the old man.

sentences.pinyin: zhè ge rèn wu hěn wēi xiǎn 。
sentences.english: This task is dangerous.

sentences.pinyin: jiǎng lì yě bù qīng chǔ 。
sentences.english: The reward is not clear either.

sentences.chinese: 附近的人都觉得不值得。
sentences.pinyin: fù jìn de rén dōu jué de bù zhí dé 。
sentences.english: People nearby all think it is not worth it.

sentences.pinyin: kě shì zá cǎo méi yǒu jù jué 。
sentences.english: But Weed does not refuse.

sentences.pinyin: tā jiē shòu le rèn wu 。
sentences.english: He accepts the task.

sentences.pinyin: tā gào sù lǎo rén ， tā huì qù 。
sentences.english: He tells the old man that he will go.

sentences.chinese: 因为孩子还在等家里人回来。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi hái zi hái zài děng jiā lǐ rén huí lái 。
sentences.english: Because the children are still waiting for their family to come back.

sentences.chinese: 因为大人不应该一直在那里。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi dà rén bú yīng gāi yì zhí zài nà lǐ 。
sentences.english: Because the adults should not stay there forever.

sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo bǎ xiǎo dōng xī shōu hǎo 。
sentences.english: Weed puts the small object away carefully.

sentences.chinese: 他不知道这个东西以后有什么用。
sentences.pinyin: tā bù zhī dào zhè ge dōng xī yǐ hòu yǒu shén me yòng 。
sentences.english: He does not know what this object will be used for later.

sentences.chinese: 可是他知道，现在应该先做这个事。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì tā zhī dào ， xiàn zài yīng gāi xiān zuò zhè ge shì 。
sentences.english: But he knows that right now, he should do this first.

sentences.pinyin: tā bú shì wèi le róng yào 。
sentences.english: He is not doing it for glory.

sentences.chinese: 也不是为了马上得到金币。
sentences.pinyin: yě bú shì wèi le mǎ shàng dé dào jīn bì 。
sentences.english: And not to get coins right away.

sentences.chinese: 他只是觉得，这个任务不能放下。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhǐ shì jué de ， zhè ge rèn wu bù néng fàng xià 。
sentences.english: He only feels that he cannot leave this task behind.

sentences.chinese: 杂草接受任务以后，朋友们都很惊讶。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo jiē shòu rèn wu yǐ hòu ， péng yǒu men dōu hěn jīng yà 。
sentences.english: After Weed accepts the task, his friends are all surprised.

sentences.pinyin: zhè ge rèn wu bù róng yì 。
sentences.english: This task is not easy.

sentences.pinyin: tā men de děng jí yě bù gāo 。
sentences.english: Their levels are not high either.

sentences.chinese: 如果只有几个人去，可能会很危险。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ zhǐ yǒu jǐ gè rén qù ， kě néng huì hěn wēi xiǎn 。
sentences.english: If only a few people go, it may be dangerous.

sentences.pinyin: kě shì zá cǎo hěn lěng jìng 。
sentences.english: But Weed is calm.

sentences.pinyin: tā huí dá ， bù néng zhī kàn biǎo miàn 。
sentences.english: He answers that they cannot only look at the surface.

sentences.pinyin: hěn duō rén zài nà biān dǎ 。
sentences.english: Many people are fighting over there.

sentences.pinyin: kě pà de rén dōu huì qù nà biān 。
sentences.english: The frightening people will all go there.

sentences.chinese: 所以这个地方可能更安静。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ zhè ge dì fāng kě néng gèng ān jìng 。
sentences.english: So this place may be quieter.

sentences.chinese: 朋友们听了以后，还是有点担心。
sentences.pinyin: péng yǒu men tīng le yǐ hòu ， hái shì yǒu diǎn dān xīn 。
sentences.english: After his friends hear this, they are still a little worried.

sentences.pinyin: kě shì tā men xiāng xìn zá cǎo 。
sentences.english: But they trust Weed.

sentences.pinyin: tā men jué dìng yì qǐ qù 。
sentences.english: They decide to go together.

sentences.pinyin: hòu lái ， liǎng gè shì bīng yě lái le 。
sentences.english: Later, two soldiers also come.

sentences.pinyin: shì bīng wèn ： “ nǐ yào qù nǎ lǐ ？ ”
sentences.english: The soldiers ask, where are you going?

sentences.chinese: 杂草回答，他要去帮助那些被带走的大人。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo huí dá ， tā yào qù bāng zhù nà xiē bèi dài zǒu de dà rén 。
sentences.english: Weed answers that he is going to help the adults who were taken away.

sentences.chinese: 士兵听了以后，也想一起去。
sentences.pinyin: shì bīng tīng le yǐ hòu ， yě xiǎng yì qǐ qù 。
sentences.english: After the soldiers hear this, they also want to go together.

sentences.chinese: 杂草看着他们，心里稳了一点。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo kàn zhe tā men ， xīn lǐ wěn le yì diǎn 。
sentences.english: Weed looks at them, and his heart becomes a little steadier.

sentences.chinese: 以前，他常常觉得自己必须一个人想办法。
sentences.pinyin: yǐ qián ， tā cháng cháng jué de zì jǐ bì xū yí gè rén xiǎng bàn fǎ 。
sentences.english: Before, he often felt he had to find a way by himself.

sentences.chinese: 可是这一次，不是只有他一个人。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì zhè yí cì ， bú shì zhǐ yǒu tā yí gè rén 。
sentences.english: But this time, he is not the only one.

sentences.pinyin: yǒu rén xiāng xìn tā 。
sentences.english: Someone believes in him.

sentences.pinyin: yě yǒu rén xiǎng gēn tā zǒu 。
sentences.english: And someone wants to follow him.

sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo méi yǒu huí dá hěn duō huà 。
sentences.english: Weed does not say much.

sentences.pinyin: tā zhǐ shì bǎ dāo ná hǎo 。
sentences.english: He only holds his knife properly.

sentences.chinese: 然后和大家一起走出去。
sentences.pinyin: rán hòu hé dà jiā yì qǐ zǒu chū qù 。
sentences.english: Then he walks out with everyone.

sentences.chinese: 杂草和朋友们走向可怕的人在的地方。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo hé péng yǒu men zǒu xiàng kě pà de rén zài de dì fāng 。
sentences.english: Weed and his friends walk toward the dangerous place.

sentences.pinyin: tā men méi yǒu mǎ shàng jìn qù 。
sentences.english: They do not go in right away.

sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo xiān zhàn zhe 。
sentences.english: Weed stands still first.

sentences.pinyin: tā guān chá sì zhōu 。
sentences.english: He looks around.

sentences.chinese: 如果一次来太多人，他们一定会很危险。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ yí cì lái tài duō rén ， tā men yí dìng huì hěn wēi xiǎn 。
sentences.english: If too many people come at once, it will be dangerous.

sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ tā xuǎn zé màn màn lái 。
sentences.english: So he chooses to move slowly.

sentences.pinyin: yí gè péng yǒu xiān zǒu chū qù 。
sentences.english: One friend goes out first.

sentences.chinese: 她把一个可怕的人带过来。
sentences.pinyin: tā bǎ yí gè kě pà de rén dài guò lái 。
sentences.english: She brings one dangerous enemy over.

sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo hé péng yǒu zài hòu miàn děng 。
sentences.english: Weed and his friends wait behind her.

sentences.chinese: 等那个人走近，他们才打。
sentences.pinyin: děng nà ge rén zǒu jìn ， tā men cái dǎ 。
sentences.english: They wait until that person comes close. Then they fight.

sentences.pinyin: dì yī cì hěn bú cuò 。
sentences.english: The first time goes well.

sentences.pinyin: dì èr cì yě kě yǐ 。
sentences.english: The second time is also okay.

sentences.chinese: 可是第三次的时候，事情变得不好。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì dì sān cì de shí hòu ， shì qíng biàn de bù hǎo 。
sentences.english: But the third time, things go wrong.

sentences.chinese: 两个可怕的人一起过来。
sentences.pinyin: liǎng gè kě pà de rén yì qǐ guò lái 。
sentences.english: Two dangerous enemies come together.

sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo méi yǒu mǎ shàng hài pà 。
sentences.english: Weed does not panic right away.

sentences.pinyin: tā ràng péng yǒu qù hòu miàn 。
sentences.english: He sends his friends to the back.

sentences.pinyin: zì jǐ zhàn zài zhè lǐ 。
sentences.english: He stays here himself.

sentences.pinyin: tā de jiàn yǐ jīng bú tài hǎo 。
sentences.english: His sword is already in bad shape.

sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ tā bǎ jiàn shōu qǐ lái 。
sentences.english: So he puts the sword away.

sentences.pinyin: tā yòng shǒu dǎ 。
sentences.english: He fights with his hands.

sentences.pinyin: dà jiā dōu hěn jīng yà 。
sentences.english: Everyone is surprised.

sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo de shǒu hěn kuài 。
sentences.english: Weed's hands are fast.

sentences.chinese: 一次又一次打在一样的地方。
sentences.pinyin: yí cì yòu yí cì dǎ zài yí yàng de dì fāng 。
sentences.english: Again and again, he hits the same place.

sentences.pinyin: tā yě bèi dǎ dào le 。
sentences.english: He gets hit too.

sentences.pinyin: kě shì tā méi yǒu huí qù 。
sentences.english: But he does not move back.

sentences.pinyin: tā yì zhí chēng zhe 。
sentences.english: He keeps holding on.

sentences.pinyin: zuì hòu ， tā men chéng gōng le 。
sentences.english: In the end, they succeed.

sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo hěn lèi ， kě shì hěn gāo xìng 。
sentences.english: Weed is tired, but happy.

sentences.chinese: 他知道，马上进去打不是答案。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhī dào ， mǎ shàng jìn qù dǎ bú shì dá àn 。
sentences.english: He knows one thing. Rushing in is not the answer.

sentences.chinese: 慢慢带过来，一个一个做好，才更稳。
sentences.pinyin: màn màn dài guò lái ， yí gè yi gè zuò hǎo ， cái gèng wěn 。
sentences.english: Bring them over slowly.

sentences.chinese: 打过以后，朋友们看着杂草。
sentences.pinyin: dǎ guò yǐ hòu ， péng yǒu men kàn zhe zá cǎo 。
sentences.english: After the fight, his friends look at Weed.

sentences.pinyin: tā men jué de tā hěn yǒu lì 。
sentences.english: They think he is strong.

sentences.chinese: 可是杂草没有只想自己变有力。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì zá cǎo méi yǒu zhī xiǎng zì jǐ biàn yǒu lì 。
sentences.english: But Weed does not only think about becoming strong himself.

sentences.chinese: 有时候，他明明可以很快打完。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu shí hòu ， tā míng míng kě yǐ hěn kuài dǎ wán 。
sentences.english: Sometimes, he clearly could finish the fight quickly.

sentences.pinyin: kě shì tā huì děng yí xià 。
sentences.english: But he waits a little.

sentences.chinese: 他让朋友也有机会练习。
sentences.pinyin: tā ràng péng yǒu yě yǒu jī huì liàn xí 。
sentences.english: He lets his friends have a chance to practice too.

sentences.chinese: 如果所有事情都让他做好，朋友就得不到经验。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ suǒ yǒu shì qíng dōu ràng tā zuò hǎo ， péng yǒu jiù dé bú dào jīng yàn 。
sentences.english: If he does everything himself, his friends will not get experience.

sentences.chinese: 杂草以前不太喜欢这样等。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo yǐ qián bú tài xǐ huan zhè yàng děng 。
sentences.english: Before, Weed did not like waiting like this.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得自己做最快，也最放心。
sentences.pinyin: tā jué de zì jǐ zuò zuì kuài ， yě zuì fàng xīn 。
sentences.english: He thought doing it himself was fastest, and safest.

sentences.pinyin: kě shì xiàn zài rèn wu bù yí yàng 。
sentences.english: But now the task is different.

sentences.chinese: 如果大家都变有力，后面的路才好走。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ dà jiā dōu biàn yǒu lì ， hòu miàn de lù cái hǎo zǒu 。
sentences.english: If everyone becomes stronger, the road ahead will be easier.

sentences.chinese: 所以他先观察每一个人。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ tā xiān guān chá měi yí gè rén 。
sentences.english: So first, he watches each person.

sentences.chinese: 谁有危险，他就过去保护。
sentences.pinyin: shuí yǒu wēi xiǎn ， tā jiù guò qù bǎo hù 。
sentences.english: If someone is in danger, he goes over and protects them.

sentences.chinese: 谁还有力，他就让那个人继续。
sentences.pinyin: shuí hái yǒu lì ， tā jiù ràng nà ge rén jì xù 。
sentences.english: If someone still has strength, he lets that person continue.

sentences.pinyin: shuí tài jí ， tā jiù tí xǐng 。
sentences.english: If someone is too rushed, he reminds them.

sentences.pinyin: zhè yàng hěn má fán 。
sentences.english: This is troublesome.

sentences.pinyin: kě shì yě hěn yǒu yòng 。
sentences.english: But it is also useful.

sentences.pinyin: tā men zǒu dé bú kuài 。
sentences.english: They do not move quickly.

sentences.chinese: 可是每一次打以后，大家都稳一点。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì měi yí cì dǎ yǐ hòu ， dà jiā dōu wěn yì diǎn 。
sentences.english: But after each fight, everyone becomes a little steadier.

sentences.chinese: 杂草慢慢明白，带大家走，不只是自己站在这里。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo màn màn míng bái ， dài dà jiā zǒu ， bù zhǐ shì zì jǐ zhàn zài zhè lǐ 。
sentences.english: Weed slowly understands something.

sentences.chinese: 也要让别人有机会往前走。
sentences.pinyin: yě yào ràng bié rén yǒu jī huì wǎng qián zǒu 。
sentences.english: He also has to let others move forward.

sentences.chinese: 任务做好以后，杂草来到一个安静的地方。
sentences.pinyin: rèn wu zuò hǎo yǐ hòu ， zá cǎo lái dào yí gè ān jìng de dì fāng 。
sentences.english: After the task is finished, Weed comes to a quiet place.

sentences.chinese: 那里需要一个很大的作品。
sentences.pinyin: nà lǐ xū yào yí gè hěn dà de zuò pǐn 。
sentences.english: That place needs a very large work.

sentences.chinese: 以前的作品已经没有了。
sentences.pinyin: yǐ qián de zuò pǐn yǐ jīng méi yǒu le 。
sentences.english: The old work is already gone.

sentences.chinese: 大家希望有一个新的作品。
sentences.pinyin: dà jiā xī wàng yǒu yí gè xīn de zuò pǐn 。
sentences.english: Everyone hopes for a new work.

sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo kàn zhe yí kuài dà shí tou 。
sentences.english: Weed looks at a large stone.

sentences.pinyin: tā yǐ qián cháng cháng yòng mù tou 。
sentences.english: Before, he often used wood.

sentences.chinese: 可是这一次，他要用石头。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì zhè yí cì ， tā yào yòng shí tou 。
sentences.english: But this time, he has to use stone.

sentences.pinyin: shí tou bǐ mù tou gèng bù róng yì 。
sentences.english: Stone is harder than wood.

sentences.pinyin: yì dāo bú duì ， jiù kě néng biàn huài 。
sentences.english: If one cut is wrong, it may be ruined.

sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo méi yǒu lì kè zuò 。
sentences.english: Weed does not start right away.

sentences.chinese: 他先站在那里，看了很多时间。
sentences.pinyin: tā xiān zhàn zài nà lǐ ， kàn le hěn duō shí jiān 。
sentences.english: First, he stands there and looks for a long time.

sentences.chinese: 他想做一个很美丽的作品。
sentences.pinyin: tā xiǎng zuò yí gè hěn měi lì de zuò pǐn 。
sentences.english: He wants to make a very beautiful work.

sentences.chinese: 可是美丽不是容易的事。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì měi lì bú shì róng yì de shì 。
sentences.english: But beauty is not easy.

sentences.pinyin: tā yuè xiǎng yuè hùn luàn 。
sentences.english: The more he thinks, the more confused he becomes.

sentences.pinyin: dì yī tiān ， tā zhī zuò le yì diǎn 。
sentences.english: On the first day, he only does a little.

sentences.pinyin: dì èr tiān ， tā hái shì bù mǎn yì 。
sentences.english: On the second day, he is still not satisfied.

sentences.pinyin: yǒu rén zài fù jìn kàn zhe 。
sentences.english: People watch nearby.

sentences.chinese: 他们希望他快一点做好。
sentences.pinyin: tā men xī wàng tā kuài yì diǎn zuò hǎo 。
sentences.english: They hope he can finish a little faster.

sentences.pinyin: kě shì zá cǎo méi yǒu jí 。
sentences.english: But Weed does not rush.

sentences.chinese: 他知道，如果现在不好做，最后一定会后悔。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhī dào ， rú guǒ xiàn zài bù hǎo zuò ， zuì hòu yí dìng huì hòu huǐ 。
sentences.english: He knows one thing.

sentences.pinyin: tā bǎ dòng zuò fàng màn 。
sentences.english: He slows his movements.

sentences.pinyin: tā yí cì zhī biàn yì diǎn 。
sentences.english: Each time, he changes only a little.

sentences.chinese: 他看石头，也看自己心里的样子。
sentences.pinyin: tā kàn shí tou ， yě kàn zì jǐ xīn lǐ de yàng zi 。
sentences.english: He looks at the stone. He also looks at the shape inside his heart.

sentences.pinyin: màn màn dì ， zuò pǐn yǒu le biǎo qíng 。
sentences.english: Slowly, the work gains an expression.

sentences.pinyin: dà jiā zhàn zài fù jìn ， gèng ān jìng 。
sentences.english: Everyone stands nearby, even quieter now.

sentences.pinyin: tā men bú shì zài děng jià gé 。
sentences.english: They are not waiting for a price.

sentences.pinyin: tā men shì zài děng yí gè dá àn 。
sentences.english: They are waiting for an answer.

sentences.chinese: 第三天，更多人来到那里。
sentences.pinyin: dì sān tiān ， gèng duō rén lái dào nà lǐ 。
sentences.english: On the third day, more people come there.

sentences.pinyin: shì bīng lái le 。
sentences.english: The soldiers come.

sentences.pinyin: lǎo rén lái le 。
sentences.english: The old people come.

sentences.pinyin: hái zi yě lái le 。
sentences.english: The children come too.

sentences.chinese: 大家都想看杂草的作品。
sentences.pinyin: dà jiā dōu xiǎng kàn zá cǎo de zuò pǐn 。
sentences.english: Everyone wants to see Weed's work.

sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo bú tài xí guàn 。
sentences.english: Weed is not used to this.

sentences.chinese: 以前在市场里，别人看作品，是为了买不买。
sentences.pinyin: yǐ qián zài shì chǎng lǐ ， bié rén kàn zuò pǐn ， shì wèi le mǎi bu mǎi 。
sentences.english: Before, in the market, people looked at his work to decide whether to buy it.

sentences.chinese: 可是这一次，别人看作品，是因为他们有希望。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì zhè yí cì ， bié rén kàn zuò pǐn ， shì yīn wèi tā men yǒu xī wàng 。
sentences.english: But this time, people look at the work because they have hope.

sentences.chinese: 这让杂草有很大的压力。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ràng zá cǎo yǒu hěn dà de yā lì 。
sentences.english: This gives Weed a lot of pressure.

sentences.pinyin: tā de shǒu yǒu diǎn yìng 。
sentences.english: His hands become a little stiff.

sentences.pinyin: tā kuài yào zuò dé bú duì 。
sentences.english: He is about to make a mistake.

sentences.pinyin: zhè shí hòu ， tā tíng zhù le 。
sentences.english: At that moment, he stops.

sentences.chinese: 他想到以前做笑脸的时候。
sentences.pinyin: tā xiǎng dào yǐ qián zuò xiào liǎn de shí hòu 。
sentences.english: He thinks of the time when he made the smiling face.

sentences.pinyin: zhī kàn biǎo miàn bú gòu 。
sentences.english: Only looking at the surface is not enough.

sentences.pinyin: zhī xiǎng kuài yì diǎn yě bú gòu 。
sentences.english: Only wanting to be faster is not enough either.

sentences.pinyin: tā yào rèn zhēn guān chá 。
sentences.english: He has to observe carefully.

sentences.chinese: 他要让作品有平静的表情。
sentences.pinyin: tā yào ràng zuò pǐn yǒu píng jìng de biǎo qíng 。
sentences.english: He has to give the work a peaceful expression.

sentences.pinyin: yú shì tā chóng xīn kāi shǐ 。
sentences.english: So he starts again.

sentences.pinyin: dòng zuò hěn xiǎo ， yě hěn wěn 。
sentences.english: His movements are small and steady.

sentences.chinese: 做好以前，他没有多回答话。
sentences.pinyin: zuò hǎo yǐ qián ， tā méi yǒu duō huí dá huà 。
sentences.english: Before it is finished, he does not answer many questions.

sentences.pinyin: zhǐ shì jì xù zuò 。
sentences.english: He only continues working.

sentences.chinese: 后来，作品终于站在那里。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái ， zuò pǐn zhōng yú zhàn zài nà lǐ 。
sentences.english: Later, the work finally stands there.

sentences.chinese: 大家看着它，很多时间都没有回答话。
sentences.pinyin: dà jiā kàn zhe tā ， hěn duō shí jiān dōu méi yǒu huí dá huà 。
sentences.english: Everyone looks at it. For a long time, no one says anything.

sentences.pinyin: yí gè hái zi qīng qīng xiào le 。
sentences.english: One child smiles softly.

sentences.pinyin: lǎo rén yě sōng yì kǒu qì 。
sentences.english: The old man also lets out a breath.

sentences.chinese: 杂草看到他们的样子，心里也平静下来。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo kàn dào tā men de yàng zi ， xīn lǐ yě píng jìng xià lái 。
sentences.english: Weed sees their faces, and his heart becomes calm too.

sentences.chinese: 他明白了，有些作品不是为了卖。
sentences.pinyin: tā míng bái le ， yǒu xiē zuò pǐn bú shì wèi le mài 。
sentences.english: He understands now. Some works are not made to be sold.

sentences.chinese: 有些作品，是为了让人重新有希望。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu xiē zuò pǐn ， shì wèi le ràng rén chóng xīn yǒu xī wàng 。
sentences.english: Some works are made to give people hope again.

sentences.chinese: 后来，杂草和朋友们来到一个很特别的地方。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái ， zá cǎo hé péng yǒu men lái dào yí gè hěn tè bié de dì fāng 。
sentences.english: Later, Weed and his friends come to a very special place.

sentences.pinyin: tā men wǎng shàng qù 。
sentences.english: They go upward.

sentences.pinyin: fēng hěn dà 。
sentences.english: The wind is strong.

sentences.pinyin: xià miàn de dì fāng gèng yuǎn 。
sentences.english: The ground below becomes farther away.

sentences.pinyin: yí gè péng yǒu hěn hài pà 。
sentences.english: One friend is very afraid.

sentences.pinyin: tā bù xiǎng wǎng xià kàn 。
sentences.english: She does not want to look down.

sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo yě yǒu diǎn jǐn zhāng 。
sentences.english: Weed is a little nervous too.

sentences.chinese: 可是他没有告诉大家自己怕。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì tā méi yǒu gào sù dà jiā zì jǐ pà 。
sentences.english: But he does not tell everyone he is afraid.

sentences.chinese: 他只是告诉大家，先看前面。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhǐ shì gào sù dà jiā ， xiān kàn qián miàn 。
sentences.english: He only tells everyone to look ahead first.

sentences.chinese: 最后，他们来到天上的城市。
sentences.pinyin: zuì hòu ， tā men lái dào tiān shàng de chéng shì 。
sentences.english: Finally, they reach the city in the sky.

sentences.pinyin: nà lǐ hěn měi 。
sentences.english: It is beautiful there.

sentences.pinyin: tiān kōng hěn jìn 。
sentences.english: The sky feels very close.

sentences.chinese: 很多鸟一样的人住在那里。
sentences.pinyin: hěn duō niǎo yí yàng de rén zhù zài nà lǐ 。
sentences.english: Many bird-like people live there.

sentences.pinyin: péng yǒu men dōu hěn jīng yà 。
sentences.english: His friends are all surprised.

sentences.pinyin: yǒu rén jué de zhè lǐ hěn piào liang 。
sentences.english: Some people think this place is beautiful.

sentences.pinyin: yǒu rén jué de zhè lǐ hěn kě pà 。
sentences.english: Some people think this place is frightening.

sentences.chinese: 因为回去的路已经没有了。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi huí qù de lù yǐ jīng méi yǒu le 。
sentences.english: Because the way back is already gone.

sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo kàn zhe sì zhōu 。
sentences.english: Weed looks around.

sentences.pinyin: tā yě bù zhī dào zěn me huí qù 。
sentences.english: He also does not know how to go back.

sentences.pinyin: kě shì tā méi yǒu mǎ shàng jí 。
sentences.english: But he does not panic right away.

sentences.chinese: 在皇家之路里，新的地方一定有新的任务。
sentences.pinyin: zài huáng jiā zhī lù lǐ ， xīn de dì fāng yí dìng yǒu xīn de rèn wu 。
sentences.english: In Royal Road, a new place must have new tasks.

sentences.chinese: 新的任务，可能就是新的机会。
sentences.pinyin: xīn de rèn wu ， kě néng jiù shì xīn de jī huì 。
sentences.english: A new task may be a new chance.

sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ tā xiān guān chá chéng shì 。
sentences.english: So first, he observes the city.

sentences.chinese: 他看道路，看商店，也看那些鸟人。
sentences.pinyin: tā kàn dào lù ， kàn shāng diàn ， yě kàn nà xiē niǎo rén 。
sentences.english: He looks at the roads, the shops, and the bird people.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉自己，先知道这个地方，再想怎么离开。
sentences.pinyin: tā gào sù zì jǐ ， xiān zhī dào zhè ge dì fāng ， zài xiǎng zěn me lí kāi 。
sentences.english: He tells himself one thing.

sentences.chinese: 杂草走进城市以后，先去了商店。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo zǒu jìn chéng shì yǐ hòu ， xiān qù le shāng diàn 。
sentences.english: After Weed enters the city, he goes to the shops first.

sentences.chinese: 这里的商店和罗森海姆不一样。
sentences.pinyin: zhè lǐ de shāng diàn hé luó sēn hǎi mǔ bù yí yàng 。
sentences.english: The shops here are different from Rosenheim.

sentences.pinyin: hěn duō dōng xī dōu hěn tè bié 。
sentences.english: Many things are very unusual.

sentences.pinyin: yǒu de dōng xī hé shì niǎo rén 。
sentences.english: Some things are right for bird people.

sentences.pinyin: yǒu de dōng xī duì rén méi yǒu yòng 。
sentences.english: Some things are useless for humans.

sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo kàn le yí gè yòu yí gè 。
sentences.english: Weed looks at one thing after another.

sentences.pinyin: tā méi yǒu lì kè mǎi 。
sentences.english: He does not buy anything right away.

sentences.pinyin: tā xiān wèn jià gé 。
sentences.english: First, he asks the prices.

sentences.pinyin: yǒu xiē jià gé hěn gāo 。
sentences.english: Some prices are high.

sentences.chinese: 有些东西看起来很好玩，可是没有价值。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu xiē dōng xī kàn qǐ lái hěn hǎo wán ， kě shì méi yǒu jià zhí 。
sentences.english: Some things look fun, but have no value.

sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo kuài yào xiǎng xiào 。
sentences.english: Weed almost wants to laugh.

sentences.pinyin: kě shì tā méi yǒu qǔ xiào 。
sentences.english: But he does not make fun of them.

sentences.chinese: 他知道，每个地方都有自己的办法。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhī dào ， měi gè dì fāng dōu yǒu zì jǐ de bàn fǎ 。
sentences.english: He knows every place has its own way of doing things.

sentences.chinese: 对自己没用的东西，对别人可能有用。
sentences.pinyin: duì zì jǐ méi yòng de dōng xī ， duì bié rén kě néng yǒu yòng 。
sentences.english: Something useless to him may be useful to someone else.

sentences.chinese: 后来，他听见一个鸟人说，这里有很多小任务。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái ， tā tīng jiàn yí gè niǎo rén shuō ， zhè lǐ yǒu hěn duō xiǎo rèn wu 。
sentences.english: Later, he hears a bird person say there are many small tasks here.

sentences.pinyin: yǒu de rèn wu jiǎng lì bù gāo 。
sentences.english: Some tasks do not give big rewards.

sentences.pinyin: yǒu de rèn wu hěn má fán 。
sentences.english: Some tasks are troublesome.

sentences.chinese: 可是杂草没有马上拒绝。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì zá cǎo méi yǒu mǎ shàng jù jué 。
sentences.english: But Weed does not refuse right away.

sentences.chinese: 他想起以前那个小东西任务。
sentences.pinyin: tā xiǎng qǐ yǐ qián nà ge xiǎo dōng xī rèn wu 。
sentences.english: He remembers the old small-object task.

sentences.chinese: 表面不好的任务，可能有长远价值。
sentences.pinyin: biǎo miàn bù hǎo de rèn wu ， kě néng yǒu cháng yuǎn jià zhí 。
sentences.english: A task that looks bad on the surface may have long-term value.

sentences.pinyin: yú shì tā xiān wèn 。
sentences.english: So first, he asks.

sentences.chinese: 他问商店，也问路上的人。
sentences.pinyin: tā wèn shāng diàn ， yě wèn lù shang de rén 。
sentences.english: He asks in the shops, and he asks people on the road.

sentences.pinyin: tā bú shì wèi le rè nào 。
sentences.english: He is not doing it for excitement.

sentences.chinese: 他是在找真正有用的线索。
sentences.pinyin: tā shì zài zhǎo zhēn zhèng yǒu yòng de xiàn suǒ 。
sentences.english: He is looking for clues that are truly useful.

sentences.chinese: 在天上城市里，杂草本来想和朋友继续练习。
sentences.pinyin: zài tiān shàng chéng shì lǐ ， zá cǎo běn lái xiǎng hé péng yǒu jì xù liàn xí 。
sentences.english: In the city in the sky, Weed originally wants to keep practicing with his friends.

sentences.chinese: 可是朋友们忽然告诉他，他们要离开一段时间。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì péng yǒu men hū rán gào sù tā ， tā men yào lí kāi yí duàn shí jiān 。
sentences.english: But his friends suddenly tell him they need to leave for a while.

sentences.pinyin: tā men jiā lǐ yǒu shì qíng 。
sentences.english: There is something happening at home.

sentences.chinese: 他们的父亲母亲也进了皇家之路。
sentences.pinyin: tā men de fù qīn mǔ qīn yě jìn le huáng jiā zhī lù 。
sentences.english: Their father and mother have also entered Royal Road.

sentences.chinese: 朋友们需要回去帮助家里人。
sentences.pinyin: péng yǒu men xū yào huí qù bāng zhù jiā lǐ rén 。
sentences.english: His friends need to go back and help their family.

sentences.chinese: 杂草听了以后，没有生气。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo tīng le yǐ hòu ， méi yǒu shēng qì 。
sentences.english: After Weed hears this, he does not get angry.

sentences.pinyin: tā zhī dào ， jiā lǐ rén hěn zhòng yào 。
sentences.english: He knows family is important.

sentences.chinese: 他自己也一直照顾家里人。
sentences.pinyin: tā zì jǐ yě yì zhí zhào gù jiā lǐ rén 。
sentences.english: He has always taken care of his own family too.

sentences.chinese: 可是他心里还是有点空。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì tā xīn lǐ hái shì yǒu diǎn kōng 。
sentences.english: But his heart still feels a little empty.

sentences.chinese: 在新的城市里，一个人做事会更麻烦。
sentences.pinyin: zài xīn de chéng shì lǐ ， yí gè rén zuò shì huì gèng má fán 。
sentences.english: In a new city, doing things alone will be more troublesome.

sentences.chinese: 没有朋友帮助，任务会更危险。
sentences.pinyin: méi yǒu péng yǒu bāng zhù ， rèn wu huì gèng wēi xiǎn 。
sentences.english: Without his friends' help, tasks will be more dangerous.

sentences.chinese: 可是杂草没有让他们留下。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì zá cǎo méi yǒu ràng tā men liú xià 。
sentences.english: But Weed does not make them stay.

sentences.pinyin: tā zhǐ shì diǎn tóu 。
sentences.english: He only nods.

sentences.chinese: 他回答，先去照顾家里人。
sentences.pinyin: tā huí dá ， xiān qù zhào gù jiā lǐ rén 。
sentences.english: He answers, go take care of your family first.

sentences.chinese: 朋友们走以后，城市还是很热闹。
sentences.pinyin: péng yǒu men zǒu yǐ hòu ， chéng shì hái shì hěn rè nào 。
sentences.english: After his friends leave, the city is still lively.

sentences.chinese: 可是杂草觉得安静了很多。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì zá cǎo jué de ān jìng le hěn duō 。
sentences.english: But Weed feels that it has become much quieter.

sentences.chinese: 他一个人站在那里，看着前面的路。
sentences.pinyin: tā yí gè rén zhàn zài nà lǐ ， kàn zhe qián miàn de lù 。
sentences.english: He stands there alone, looking at the road ahead.

sentences.chinese: 以前，他常常一个人做事。
sentences.pinyin: yǐ qián ， tā cháng cháng yí gè rén zuò shì 。
sentences.english: Before, he often did things alone.

sentences.chinese: 现在，他又要一个人开始。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài ， tā yòu yào yí gè rén kāi shǐ 。
sentences.english: Now, he has to start alone again.

sentences.pinyin: kě shì zhè yí cì bù yí yàng 。
sentences.english: But this time is different.

sentences.chinese: 他已经知道，有些人离开，不是不信他。
sentences.pinyin: tā yǐ jīng zhī dào ， yǒu xiē rén lí kāi ， bú shì bú xìn tā 。
sentences.english: He already knows that when some people leave, it does not mean they do not trust him.

sentences.chinese: 只是每个人都有自己的任务。
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ shì měi gè rén dōu yǒu zì jǐ de rèn wu 。
sentences.english: It only means everyone has their own task.

sentences.chinese: 外面世界里，李贤也有自己的问题。
sentences.pinyin: wài miàn shì jiè lǐ ， lǐ xián yě yǒu zì jǐ de wèn tí 。
sentences.english: In the outside world, Lee Hyun also has his own problem.

sentences.chinese: 他回到家以后，先看金币。
sentences.pinyin: tā huí dào jiā yǐ hòu ， xiān kàn jīn bì 。
sentences.english: After he returns home, he looks at the coins first.

sentences.pinyin: jiā lǐ de jīn bì bù duō 。
sentences.english: There are not many coins at home.

sentences.pinyin: xū yào mǎi dōng xī 。
sentences.english: They need to buy things.

sentences.pinyin: yě xū yào zhào gù nǎi nai 。
sentences.english: They also need to take care of Grandmother.

sentences.pinyin: lǐ xià yán hái yào xué xí 。
sentences.english: Lee Hayan still needs to study.

sentences.chinese: 李贤坐在桌子前，看了很多时间。
sentences.pinyin: lǐ xián zuò zài zhuō zi qián ， kàn le hěn duō shí jiān 。
sentences.english: Lee Hyun sits at the table and looks for a long time.

sentences.pinyin: tā bù xiǎng ràng jiā lǐ rén dān xīn 。
sentences.english: He does not want his family to worry.

sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ tā cháng cháng huí dá ： méi shì 。
sentences.english: So he often answers, it's okay.

sentences.chinese: 可是金币不会因为他回答没事就变多。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì jīn bì bú huì yīn wèi tā huí dá méi shì jiù biàn duō 。
sentences.english: But the coins will not become more just because he says it is okay.

sentences.pinyin: tā ná qǐ běn zi ， màn màn jì xià 。
sentences.english: He picks up a notebook and slowly writes things down.

sentences.pinyin: shén me dōng xī bì xū mǎi 。
sentences.english: What things must be bought.

sentences.pinyin: shén me dōng xī kě yǐ xiān bù mǎi 。
sentences.english: What things can wait.

sentences.chinese: 什么地方可以少用一点。
sentences.pinyin: shén me dì fāng kě yǐ shǎo yòng yì diǎn 。
sentences.english: Where they can use a little less.

sentences.pinyin: tā jué de yā lì hěn dà 。
sentences.english: He feels a lot of pressure.

sentences.pinyin: kě shì tā méi yǒu luàn 。
sentences.english: But he does not lose control.

sentences.chinese: 他已经在皇家之路里学会一个事。
sentences.pinyin: tā yǐ jīng zài huáng jiā zhī lù lǐ xué huì yí gè shì 。
sentences.english: He has already learned one thing in Royal Road.

sentences.chinese: 事情越不容易，越要一步一步做。
sentences.pinyin: shì qíng yuè bù róng yì ， yuè yào yí bù yi bù zuò 。
sentences.english: The harder something is, the more he has to do it step by step.

sentences.pinyin: bù néng zhī jí 。
sentences.english: He cannot only rush.

sentences.pinyin: yě bù néng zhī chěng qiáng 。
sentences.english: And he cannot only pretend to be strong.

sentences.pinyin: dì èr tiān ， lǐ xià yán huí jiā 。
sentences.english: The next day, Lee Hayan comes home.

sentences.chinese: 她看见李贤还在桌子前。
sentences.pinyin: tā kàn jiàn lǐ xián hái zài zhuō zi qián 。
sentences.english: She sees Lee Hyun still sitting at the table.

sentences.pinyin: tā wèn ： “ nǐ lèi ma ？ ”
sentences.english: She asks, are you tired?

sentences.pinyin: lǐ xián yǐ qián xiǎng huí dá méi shì 。
sentences.english: Before, Lee Hyun would have wanted to answer, it's okay.

sentences.chinese: 可是这一次，他停了一下。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì zhè yí cì ， tā tíng le yí xià 。
sentences.english: But this time, he pauses.

sentences.pinyin: rán hòu tā huí dá ： “ yǒu yì diǎn lèi 。 ”
sentences.english: Then he answers, a little tired.

sentences.pinyin: lǐ xià yán méi yǒu qǔ xiào tā 。
sentences.english: Lee Hayan does not make fun of him.

sentences.pinyin: tā zhǐ shì zuò zài fù jìn 。
sentences.english: She only sits nearby.

sentences.chinese: 李贤忽然觉得，自己不是一个人。
sentences.pinyin: lǐ xián hū rán jué de ， zì jǐ bú shì yí gè rén 。
sentences.english: Lee Hyun suddenly feels that he is not alone.
